description: This file defines a PHPUnit test class 'LoginLogServiceTest' for testing the 'LoginService' related to login logging functionality within the OrangeHRM Authentication system. It includes setup and multiple test methods to verify login log creation, retrieval, and OIDC login addition. The class tests interactions with DAOs, services, and session components, and uses mock objects to simulate dependencies.

classes.name: LoginLogServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that conducts unit tests on the login logging functionalities of the 'LoginService'. It verifies DAO retrieval, login logging behavior, and OIDC login handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of 'LoginService'.

methods.name: testGetLoginLogDao
methods.description: Tests that 'getLoginLogDao' returns an instance of 'LoginLogDao'.

methods.name: testSaveLoginLog
methods.description: Creates mock dependencies to test the 'addLogin' method for saving login logs, verifying properties such as user ID, username, role, and login time.

methods.name: testAddOIDCLogin
methods.description: Tests the 'addOIDCLogin' method to ensure it properly logs an OIDC login event with correct attributes.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, instantiating the 'LoginService'.

methods.name: testGetLoginLogDao
methods.description: Verifies that the login service correctly provides the login log DAO.

methods.name: testSaveLoginLog
methods.description: Tests the creation and saving of a login log entry with mocked user and session dependencies.

methods.name: testAddOIDCLogin
methods.description: Verifies the logging of an OIDC login for a specific user.
